.venv/bin/python -I -B - <<'PY'
import collections,hashlib,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
task=root/'evidence/infrastructure/SC-LAB1-NONPROCESS-CLOSEOUT-001'
rows=json.loads((task/'starting-protection-inventory.json').read_text())['files']
changes=[]
for row in rows:
    p=root/row['path']
    if not p.exists():
        changes.append({'path':row['path'],'change':'missing'})
        continue
    if row['type']=='file':
        now=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if now!=row['sha256']:
            changes.append({'path':row['path'],'change':'bytes','before':row['sha256'],'after':now})
        elif p.stat().st_mtime_ns!=row['mtime_ns']:
            changes.append({'path':row['path'],'change':'mtime_only'})
    else:
        changes.append({'path':row['path'],'change':'nonfile_baseline','type':row['type']})
print(json.dumps({'checked':len(rows),'byte_count':sum(x.get('size',0) for x in rows),'changes':changes,'type_counts':dict(collections.Counter(x['type'] for x in rows))},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
PY
